kicker: For the night that caught you nothing
truth: You fished all night and came home empty. Let down the net anyway.
prayer: Lord, I'm tired of trying the same empty thing. When You tell me to let down the net again, let me obey before I understand why. Nevertheless, at Your word. In Jesus' name, amen.

verse.text: Nevertheless at thy word I will let down the net.

save: Save this for one more try
